custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate custody is onchain; this does not establish whole-parent reserve custody or enforceable legal priority. Lender assets are intentionally deployed into Morpho borrower markets; allocation and available liquidity change. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown. Whole-book custody is mixed: at Ethereum block 26197300 (2026-10-15T10:25:11Z), 2539261986915786569480541 raw USDS of lender claims were secured by custodial cbBTC, about 6.2% of 40957315564631184834483764 raw total assets. This is an allocation weight, not a direct BTC holding or a custodian reserve share; legal safeguards remain unresolved.
